comment: task toolhead-r11c-extruder-heads — the RM.Extruder tool-head rows, representative-row form (the B1/r11e walk-declaration convention). Eight upstream walk families, one representative row each per family statement: (1) the metal Shape_Extruder forging rows (Loader_Recipes_Handlers.java:750-762 head subset: raw shovel/sword/hoe/saw/pickaxe/axe + finished file/hammer), walk = OreDictPrefix.VALUES x containsAny(EXTRUDER_FODDER, INGOT_BASED, GEM_BASED) x the material's EXTRUDER gate — representative input gt6:ingot_iron; EUt 96 (the aHot forging column), duration = RecipeMapHandlerPrefixForging.getCosts (max(16, 1+|(meltingPoint-293)*weight|/(75*96)); the Iron representative computes 185/369/554/1107 t; upstream the duration is per-material runtime, the JSON carries the Iron representative value). (2) the metal Shape_SimpleEx mirror (:783-795 head subset), same walk + DUST_BASED, EUt 16, duration = UT.Code.units(outputU, U, 64, T) = 64 t per output unit (64/96/128/192/384). (3)+(4) the stone stonetypes rows (RM.java:410-414/:417 Shape + :423-427/:430 SimpleEx), walk = the GT6 stone-family materials x the four block forms (aStone/aCobble/aSmooth/aDustBlock) — representative input minecraft:stone. (5)+(6) the BlockStones metatype rows (BlockStones.java:293-297/:300 + :308-312/:315), walk = every BlockStones metatype block — representative input gt6:granite. (7)+(8) the Blackstone special rows (Loader_Recipes_Extruder.java:51-58 + :66-73; the SPEC's :51-53 shovel/sword/hoe lines plus their :54-55/:58 pickaxe/axe/hammer continuations), representative input minecraft:blackstone — DECLARED DEVIATION: the upstream input is Module_Blackstone_Generator, a port-absent item; the port substitutes the Blackstone stone item (GT6Anvils: OP.stone.dat(Blackstone) = vanilla BLACKSTONE), counts and durations verbatim. DECLARED DEVIATION (both metal families): upstream each aHot statement emits a config-conditional row pair (96 EUt under EXTRUDER_SIMPLE.NOT + 16 EUt under EXTRUDER_SIMPLE); the config-less JSON keeps one row per statement at its family's column, so both mold families answer on every config. DECLARED POOL: the Shape_Extruder/SimpleEx non-head rows (plate/plateCurved/rod/rodLong/bolt/gear/gearSmall/ingot/block/casing/wire/foil/pipe families) and the mold-crafting chain (needs the port-absent Shape_Extruder_Empty) stay pooled; the plate/rod rows already pour via GT6RecipesExtruder (FMLCommonSetup). Molds enter the second input slot and are never consumed (Recipe.sNotConsumable <- gt6:extruder_shapes tag membership; the upstream size-0 marker port, remember id478).
